text: 从工业和信息化部了解到，中国算力平台已实现全国一体化算力统筹监测，我国算力“一张网、一盘棋、一体化”发展格局基本形成。中国算力平台是国家级综合性算力服务平台，目前已经汇聚了超万家注册企业用户，上架2000多项优质算力产品，接入各类大模型超300个，为广大开发者提供算力调用服务，累计沉淀数十亿条算力监测大数据。（央视新闻）
text_en: Learned from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology that China's computing power platform has achieved nationwide integrated computing power coordinated monitoring, and the development pattern of "one network, one chessboard, integration" for China's computing power has basically taken shape. China's computing power platform is a national-level comprehensive computing power service platform. It has currently gathered more than 10,000 registered enterprise users, listed more than 2,000 high-quality computing power products, connected more than 300 large models of various types, provided computing power invocation services for developers, and accumulated billions of pieces of computing power monitoring big data. (CCTV News)
